title: Getting a little discouraged and would like some advice
author: No_Departure7494
selftext:
**This is a long one but here is the tl;dr**

**While trying to abide by semi-realistic combat scenarios - both ships in my game open fire with anti-ship missiles, tomahawks, but as with actual naval ships, have more defensive weapons than offensive. So they exhaust themselves and refuse to engage, refuse to get vicious. SO they just sit there firing guns at infantry off the coast for the rest of the game. How would you fix this?**



In this game I'm making it starts out as 2 full scale militaries facing off. Generic, but fun. I am making this game for myself and it started out great but now is kind of plateauing. 

How the battle starts

\- Both ships hurl volleys of missiles at each other, but each Destroyer and Cruiser are armed with a realistic number of interceptor munitions.   
\- The interceptor munitions (Sm-2, Sm-6, and Sea Sparrows) are more plentiful than the offensive weaponry, which is realistic.

But then, there comes a point where both navies are totally useless. Comically so.

Theyboth exhaust their offensive weapons, use up the rest on non-stealth aircraft, and sit there firing their 5 inch guns off the coast, basically giant paperweight because while those are effective at close range, they're not too great from a distance. Though, it adds a great deal of lively ambience to the scene.

  
My question - How would YOU remedy this without ruining the granular level of realism it has? Right now I am begging Claude to implement a replenishing stage which currently works for aircraft but is not working well for ships. A supply ship comes along, you line up beside it (Local, not far), replenish ammo, and the attritional war continues.

But it's like the AI won't get nasty or aggressive enough for my liking. They won't strike naval ships, kind of just circle around and take out other aircraft.... The navies seem so freaking useless.

comments.author: MidSerpent
comments.body: I mean, what about cannon, sure you can shoot down missiles but what about shells?

comments.author: TheSpriteWizard
comments.body: Supply boats. Small little units that can go from your base to your units with munitions to get them back in the game. Or have them head to a harbor of some sort and stock up. Just like real life.

comments.author: HitMePat
comments.body: What would Claude say if you gave him the text of this exact post?
